mapper.sql: out_trade_no as outTradeNo, seller_sub_mchid as sellerSubMchid, seller_type as sellerType, seller_id as sellerId, platform_sub_mchid as platformSubMchid, total_fen as totalFen, seller_fen as sellerFen, held_fen as heldFen, commission_fen as commissionFen, reserve_fen as reserveFen, combine_out_trade_no as combineOutTradeNo, seller_transaction_id as sellerTransactionId
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_combine_order (out_trade_no, seller_sub_mchid, seller_type, seller_id, platform_sub_mchid, total_fen, seller_fen, held_fen, commission_fen, reserve_fen) values (#{outTradeNo}, #{sellerSubMchid}, #{sellerType}, #{sellerId}, #{platformSubMchid}, #{totalFen}, #{sellerFen}, #{heldFen}, #{commissionFen}, #{reserveFen})
mapper.update: update ecom_combine_order set combine_out_trade_no = #{combineOutTradeNo}, seller_transaction_id = #{sellerTransactionId} where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and combine_out_trade_no is null and seller_transaction_id is null
mapper.sql: id, combine_out_trade_no as combineOutTradeNo, role, out_trade_no as outTradeNo, business_out_trade_no as businessOutTradeNo, sub_mchid as subMchid, amount_fen as amountFen, profit_sharing as profitSharing, transaction_id as transactionId
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_combine_sub_order (combine_out_trade_no, role, out_trade_no, business_out_trade_no, sub_mchid, amount_fen, profit_sharing) values (#{combineOutTradeNo}, #{role}, #{outTradeNo}, #{businessOutTradeNo}, #{subMchid}, #{amountFen}, #{profitSharing})
mapper.select: select from ecom_combine_sub_order where combine_out_trade_no = #{combineOutTradeNo} order by case role when 'SELLER' then 0 else 1 end
mapper.update: update ecom_combine_sub_order set transaction_id = #{transactionId} where combine_out_trade_no = #{combineOutTradeNo} and role = #{role} and transaction_id is null
mapper.sql: out_refund_no as outRefundNo, parent_out_refund_no as parentOutRefundNo, business_out_trade_no as businessOutTradeNo, role, sub_mchid as subMchid, sub_out_trade_no as subOutTradeNo, transaction_id as transactionId, refund_fen as refundFen, total_fen as totalFen, state, refund_id as refundId, fail_reason as failReason
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_combine_refund (out_refund_no, parent_out_refund_no, business_out_trade_no, role, sub_mchid, sub_out_trade_no, transaction_id, refund_fen, total_fen, state) values (#{outRefundNo}, #{parentOutRefundNo}, #{businessOutTradeNo}, #{role}, #{subMchid}, #{subOutTradeNo}, #{transactionId}, #{refundFen}, #{totalFen}, #{state})
mapper.select: select from ecom_combine_refund where parent_out_refund_no = #{parentOutRefundNo} order by case role when 'SELLER' then 0 else 1 end
select from ecom_combine_refund where business_out_trade_no = #{businessOutTradeNo} order by created_at, out_refund_no
mapper.update: update ecom_combine_refund set state = #{state}, refund_id = coalesce(#{refundId}, refund_id), fail_reason = #{failReason} where out_refund_no = #{outRefundNo} and state = #{expectedState}
mapper.select: select o.out_trade_no as outTradeNo, o.seller_sub_mchid as sellerSubMchid, o.seller_type as sellerType, o.seller_id as sellerId, o.platform_sub_mchid as platformSubMchid, o.total_fen as totalFen, o.seller_fen as sellerFen, o.held_fen as heldFen, o.commission_fen as commissionFen, o.reserve_fen as reserveFen, o.combine_out_trade_no as combineOutTradeNo, o.seller_transaction_id as sellerTransactionId, r.id as registrationId from cms_registration r join ecom_combine_order o on CAST(o.out_trade_no AS BINARY) = CAST(r.registration_no AS BINARY) where r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = #{topicId} and o.seller_transaction_id is not null order by r.id

select distinct r.owner_id from ecom_combine_order o join cms_registration r on CAST(r.registration_no AS BINARY) = CAST(o.out_trade_no AS BINARY) and r.owner_type = 1 join cms_topic t on t.id = r.owner_id and t.is_settlement = 1 where o.seller_transaction_id is not null and exists (select 1 from coop_settlement_original_component c where c.topic_id = r.owner_id and c.payer_registration_id = r.id) and not exists (select 1 from ecom_combine_settlement s where s.business_out_trade_no = o.out_trade_no and s.topic_id = r.owner_id) order by r.owner_id limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: id, out_order_no as outOrderNo, business_out_trade_no as businessOutTradeNo, topic_id as topicId, seller_sub_mchid as sellerSubMchid, seller_transaction_id as sellerTransactionId, seller_fen as sellerFen, held_fen as heldFen, platform_fen as platformFen, shortfall_fen as shortfallFen, surplus_fen as surplusFen, plan_hash as planHash, state, manual_reason as manualReason, wx_order_id as wxOrderId
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_combine_settlement (out_order_no, business_out_trade_no, topic_id, seller_sub_mchid, seller_transaction_id, seller_fen, held_fen, platform_fen, shortfall_fen, surplus_fen, plan_hash, state, manual_reason) values (#{outOrderNo}, #{businessOutTradeNo}, #{topicId}, #{sellerSubMchid}, #{sellerTransactionId}, #{sellerFen}, #{heldFen}, #{platformFen}, #{shortfallFen}, #{surplusFen}, #{planHash}, #{state}, #{manualReason})
mapper.select: select from ecom_combine_settlement where business_out_trade_no = #{businessOutTradeNo} and topic_id = #{topicId}
select from ecom_combine_settlement where business_out_trade_no = #{businessOutTradeNo} order by id

select from ecom_combine_settlement o where o.state = 'PLANNED' and exists ( select 1 from coop_settlement_original_component c join cms_registration r on r.id = c.payer_registration_id where c.topic_id = o.topic_id and CAST(r.registration_no AS BINARY) = CAST(o.business_out_trade_no AS BINARY)) and not exists ( select 1 from coop_settlement_original_component c join cms_registration r on r.id = c.payer_registration_id join coop_settlement s on s.id = c.settlement_id where c.topic_id = o.topic_id and CAST(r.registration_no AS BINARY) = CAST(o.business_out_trade_no AS BINARY) and (s.del_flag != 0 or s.payable_time is null or s.payable_time > #{now})) and not exists ( select 1 from coop_complaint c where c.del_flag = 0 and c.topic_id = o.topic_id and c.status < 3) order by o.id limit #{limit}
select from ecom_combine_settlement where state = #{state} order by id limit #{limit}
mapper.sql: out_return_no as outReturnNo, combine_settlement_id as combineSettlementId, parent_out_refund_no as parentOutRefundNo, return_mchid as returnMchid, amount_fen as amountFen, state, wx_return_no as wxReturnNo, fail_reason as failReason
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_combine_return (out_return_no, combine_settlement_id, parent_out_refund_no, return_mchid, amount_fen, state) values (#{outReturnNo}, #{combineSettlementId}, #{parentOutRefundNo}, #{returnMchid}, #{amountFen}, #{state})
mapper.select: select from ecom_combine_return where combine_settlement_id = #{combineSettlementId} order by created_at, out_return_no
mapper.update: update ecom_combine_return set state = #{state}, wx_return_no = coalesce(#{wxReturnNo}, wx_return_no), fail_reason = #{failReason} where out_return_no = #{outReturnNo} and state = #{expectedState}
mapper.sql: id, source, business_out_trade_no as businessOutTradeNo, topic_id as topicId, settlement_id as settlementId, line_type as lineType, payee_member_id as payeeMemberId, amount_fen as amountFen, state, paid_reference as paidReference, paid_by as paidBy, paid_at as paidAt
mapper.insert: insert into ecom_supplier_payable (source, business_out_trade_no, topic_id, settlement_id, line_type, payee_member_id, amount_fen, state) values (#{source}, #{businessOutTradeNo}, #{topicId}, #{settlementId}, #{lineType}, #{payeeMemberId}, #{amountFen}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: select from ecom_supplier_payable where business_out_trade_no = #{businessOutTradeNo} order by id
mapper.update: update ecom_supplier_payable set state = 'PAID', paid_reference = #{paidReference}, paid_by = #{paidBy}, paid_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) where id = #{id} and state = 'PENDING'
update ecom_supplier_payable set state = 'HOLD_REFUND' where business_out_trade_no = #{businessOutTradeNo} and state = 'PENDING'
mapper.sql: join wx_verified_payment_fact f on f.id = c.payment_fact_id join ecom_combine_order o on CAST(o.out_trade_no AS BINARY) = CAST(f.business_out_trade_no AS BINARY) and CAST(o.combine_out_trade_no AS BINARY) = CAST(f.wx_out_trade_no AS BINARY)
mapper.select:
select coalesce(( select sum(c.original_amount) from coop_settlement_original_component c
where c.settlement_id = #{settlementId}), 0) + coalesce(( select sum(a.amount) from coop_settlement_original_adjustment a join coop_settlement_original_component c on c.id = a.component_id
where a.settlement_id = #{settlementId}), 0)

select count(*) from wx_verified_payment_fact f join ecom_combine_order o on CAST(o.out_trade_no AS BINARY) = CAST(f.business_out_trade_no AS BINARY) and CAST(o.combine_out_trade_no AS BINARY) = CAST(f.wx_out_trade_no AS BINARY) where f.id = #{paymentFactId}
